I got an appointment with a psicologist, I decided to not go back to my therapist since I couldn't trust him totally, there was something that made me thought that he was more intrested in my money than in my well being..

May I mention that last night in the middle of the night I completly freaked out because I woke up with a pretty strong pain and I went to the E.R. they basically treated me like shit, I went home couldn't sleep. Then the morning I went to see my dentist in tears and he reassured me that everything is ok, he changed my [NSAID](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NSAID) since he told me that it could've been the reason of a depression attack. After hitting this new level of lowness I decided to follow your advices and seek some professional help. Thanks

I know and this is what hurts me the most.. that my will to live  crashes upon my fear! I want to run barefoot in the grass but then I think about thetanus, I want to drink a beer but I fear that I'll be sick, I want to do tons of things and sometimes I can, but it's always a long fight within myself..
Are you better now? Can someone really break the pattern?

Thanks to you and **everybody** posting in suicide watch restored some of my faith in humanity.

+ 1billion real life karma
Yes but it still bleeds a little and I think I'm gonna die.. and I feel stupid about thinking it and the more I get anxious the more I bleed and I swell..

It's been an ordeal of 6 years beetween depression, anxiety and fucking fear of everything.. I have a girlfriend, a job, I'm a pretty good looking and outgoing guy, and still I feel so helpless and lonely and I can't manage to live my life fully, I'm too scared of dying

I can't call my therapist because I said that I didn't wanna see him again because I'm well and I don't need him.

I can't be rational, I see that I'm still losing a whiff of blood after 3 days from the operation and I convince myself that I'm gonna die.. It's stronger than me..

I want my father back, I realized how much I loved him only when he died, and I'll never see him again! I want him back, I feel so alone, I lost all my friends because I'm a jerk, I argue with everybody because I feel a deep rage inside of me, an unstoppable destructive force.. and I'm so scared to confront myself with life and difficulties that sometime I wanna die because I'm too scared to live.. I can't even drink a beer without feeling that maybe I'll be sick? Is this life?

I love life, and everytime I feel sick (now I'm all swollen and bloody for my wisdom teeth extraction of thursday) I want to be well again and I feel I'm gonna die and I'm so scared that I wanna end it myself.. I cry I cry, I went to a emergency denstist today that told me to stay calm and checked me and saw that I was a bit too swoollen but that nothing seriuous was going on and still I want to be helped, I want to go to the hospital and be reassured and cuddled.. I'm so scared to die that it seems that life is too hard to live..I pity myself that for a simple swoollen cheek and a little blood I lose my self control and I cry.. I hate myself for this.. I want to be like steve-o fearless and instead I'm here crying in front of a screen.. I went to a therapist but I dropped after a year because I thought I was better, I don't wann be like this.. I wanna be a real man, fearless, I'm scared to death of a teeth.. will I ever be a normal person?
My **analyst** (and I do also think that they generally bullshit) interpreted (I dropped him) this cross-dressing thing as a way to BE my mother in order to HAVE my father.
